title: Murasu due to cross Andhra coast tonight; gusts up to 120 kmph
body: NDTV Profit: Murasu is forecast to cross the Andhra Pradesh coast between midnight and early Tuesday, with winds of 100–110 kmph and gusts up to 120 kmph. IMD's window: Nellore to Narsapur, 11:30 pm Mon to 4 am Tue. Pawan Kalyan told officials to stay alert as it nears the Nellore coast (The Hindu). 12 Vijayawada flights are off, including Hyderabad routes. Six Telangana districts were on orange alert Monday; Hyderabad was not.
